Please eliminate the interferences from the surrounding environment and sleep in the middle area of the pillow.

device_title_faq_1: Unable to connect. Check the following
device_details_faq_1:
1、That the pillow is powered on and has sufficient battery.
1）Press and hold the Power button, if the indicator lights up green the device has sufficient battery.
2）If the indicator flashes red it needs to be charged.
2、The phone's Bluetooth is enabled.
3、The pillow and phone are within %7$s meters of each other.
4、The pillow isn't paired to any other devices.
If the issue persists, restart the device and app.
device_details_faq_2:
1、The device is powered off
2、The pillow is more than 5 m from your phone.
3、The pillow may be out of battery.
device_title_faq_3: I used the pillow, but there's no report
device_details_faq_3:
1、Enable Bluetooth on your phone, then open the app and go to the pillow's screen (make sure you are close to the pillow and it's connected), then sync to get your report.
2、Lie on the pillow, if there isn't any heart rate or respiratory rate data make sure the earphones are plugged into the controller properly.
3、Try taking a nap (at least %4$s minutes). Make sure your head is near the center of the pillow and check if there's any data after.
device_title_faq_4: Why is there a heart rate and respiratory rate reading even though I'm not on the pillow?
device_details_faq_4:
1、 It takes about 10–15 sec for the pillow to detect that you have left it.
2、There are vibrations nearby, some scenarios include:
1）Someone sitting next to or on the pillow, someone jumping on the bed, the linen being changed, pets on the bed
2）Someone walking within 1m of the pillow
3）A fan blowing directly on the pillow
4）A washing machine running nearby
5）Construction happening nearby
device_title_faq_5: The heart rate and respiratory rate data doesn't seem accurate
device_details_faq_5:
1、If you haven't been lying down for long or your movements are too big the data will be affected. Lay down and hold still, the data will become more accurate and stabilize.
2、 For better results, center your head on the pillow. Don't sit on the pillow, and don't rest your back or other body parts on it, as this will affect data accuracy.
device_title_faq_6: Why doesn't the pillow have real-time data？
device_details_faq_6:
When lying on the pillow the app shows that the pillow is connected, but there is no heart rate or respiratory rate, and the device is displayed as "Offline".
Unplug the earphones, then plug them back in and check if there's data.
device_title_faq_7: The sleep report doesn't seem accurate？
device_details_faq_7:
The device uses sensors to detect heart rate, respiratory rate, and other signals within a given range. It then uses this data to determine when you fell asleep and sleep duration.
Your head could leave the pillow without you knowing during the night.
The pillow may pick up interference from the vibration of other things nearby such as a washing machine, fan, construction, or another person. These could cause the pillow to think you are awake.
Sometimes just laying down quietly can be detected as being asleep due to the similarities between the two.
It's also important to use the pillow as described in the manual to ensure the best results.
device_title_faq_8: Does the app need to be open during use?
device_details_faq_8:
No, you only need the app to connect the device the first time. After that it can automatically track your sleep.
You also need the app to view data. To do this, enable Bluetooth on your phone, then open the app (make sure the device is close by), then sync the device to view your report.
device_title_faq_9: How does the pillow track my sleep?
device_details_faq_9: The pillow is able to detect vibrations from breathing and your heart beating. This data can be used to get vital indicators such as heart rate and respiratory rate for your sleep report.
device_title_faq_10: Why isn't the pillow's controller charging?
device_details_faq_10:
1、If the controller is over 45°C it will stop charging until it cools.
2、 Check the adapter and cable for issues. Try switching to a 5V 1A adapter, another cable, or socket. Type C to Type C cables aren't supported.
